Variants.Content: The Nori are part of the clan tradition of the northern mountains, and their life is closer to hills, woodlands, hunting trails and scattered settlements than to the knights' manor in the southern plains. It should be emphasized that it plays the role of road, mountain supply, group gathering and winter refuge in the northern local network.

Entry Norrey Keep Local families also rely on firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries to survive the long winter; if any road, well, spring, or wharf fails, the price will fall on them first.

Entry Norrey Keep They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the North; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.
Entry Norrey Keep Entry Norrey Keep

Entry Norrey Keep If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Norrey Keep A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Norrey Keep They care about firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries that can survive the long winter. They also care about whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, they see whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
